scene.language: In this scenario, um, the workers are working at their stations. One of them raises his hand to signal that he needs the object that we want to bring him. Worker B raises his hand to signal that he needs the red object. First we check to see if the object is in the basket. It's in the basket. We want to bring it to him, so we pick it up and give it to Worker [0]B.[1][2]
